description: This file defines authorization-related API types for Kubernetes, including SubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectAccessReview, LocalSubjectAccessReview, and associated structures for resource attributes, rules, and status.

classes.name: SubjectAccessReview
classes.description: Represents a request to check if a user or group can perform an action, with metadata and status.

classes.name: SelfSubjectAccessReview
classes.description: Represents a request to check if the current user can perform an action, with metadata and status.

classes.name: LocalSubjectAccessReview
classes.description: Represents a namespace-scoped access review request, with metadata and status.

classes.name: ResourceAttributes
classes.description: Contains attributes for resource-based access requests, such as namespace, verb, group, resource, subresource, name, and selectors.

classes.name: LabelSelectorAttributes
classes.description: Specifies label-based access restrictions, including raw selector and parsed requirements.

classes.name: FieldSelectorAttributes
classes.description: Specifies field-based access restrictions, including raw selector and parsed requirements.

classes.name: NonResourceAttributes
classes.description: Contains attributes for non-resource requests, such as URL path and HTTP verb.

classes.name: SubjectAccessReviewSpec
classes.description: Describes the details of an access request, including resource or non-resource attributes, user, groups, extra info, and UID.

classes.name: ExtraValue
classes.description: A type alias for a list of strings, used for extra user info.

classes.name: SelfSubjectAccessReviewSpec
classes.description: Specifies resource or non-resource attributes for self access review.

classes.name: SubjectAccessReviewStatus
classes.description: Indicates whether an access request is allowed, denied, with optional reason and error info.

classes.name: SelfSubjectRulesReview
classes.description: Enumerates actions the current user can perform within a namespace.

classes.name: SelfSubjectRulesReviewSpec
classes.description: Specifies the namespace for which to evaluate rules.

classes.name: SubjectRulesReviewStatus
classes.description: Contains allowed resource and non-resource rules, with evaluation status.

classes.name: ResourceRule
classes.description: Defines allowed actions (verbs) on resources, including API groups, resource names, and resources.

classes.name: NonResourceRule
classes.description: Defines allowed actions (verbs) on non-resource URLs.
